headline: Approved the consent agenda; discussed a housing bill's employer and employee savings provision.
summary: Commissioner Gomes gave an update on Wallingford Works for Housing (WWFH) and mentioned an education video. Commissioner Bau suggested posting the video to other community forums. The group discussed the Employer/Employee Savings provision in CT Bill 8002 as a workforce and recruitment tool, and Commissioner Bau will contact GNHCC/QCC and CBIA for more information.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Gomes made a motion to approve the consent agenda, Commissioner Bau seconded the motion. Consent Agenda was unanimously approved.
